# Route 53 Resolver

**Parity grade: A** · SDK `aws-sdk-go-v2/service/route53resolver@v1.54.4` · last audited 2026-10-11 (`1940758f8`)

### Known gaps

- Embedded DNS forwarding: the query source is the emulator process, not the outbound endpoint ENIs (the host cannot bind the ENI private IPs; dns_forward.go exchange/exchangeDoH dial from the host address).
- Docker-launched resources are not auto-pointed at the embedded DNS; a query maps to a VPC only when its source address is an EC2 ENI/instance private IP or inside a subnet CIDR.

### Structural gaps

These do not block an A grade — no implementation could produce real data here because the underlying data source cannot exist in an emulator.

- CreateFirewallRule/UpdateFirewallRule FirewallAdvancedContentCategory/FirewallAdvancedThreatCategory/PartnerThreatProtection: the values are per-account catalogs (AWS-managed categories, AWS Marketplace partner subscriptions) that ListFirewallRuleTypes enumerates; this emulator has neither, so its catalog is empty and these are rejected.

### Deferred

- none -- full op surface audited this pass
